name: Hidden Genius Project Immersion Program
what_you_do: You can join a free 15 month program (800+ hours) for Black male high school students. The page describes mentorship, coding and entrepreneurship training.
who_can_apply: Black male students entering grades 9, 10 or 11. Students in 11th or 12th grade now cannot apply. No coding experience needed. Must commit to the full 15 months.
pay_detail: Free to join; no stipend listed
deadline_text: The 2027 to 2028 application is open. It closes Feb 26, 2027.
how_to_apply: Apply online with the form linked on the Immersion Program apply page. Choose your site on the form.
notes: The apply page lists sites in Oakland, Richmond, Los Angeles, Long Beach and Philadelphia. The old immersion link now opens a past 2025 event page.
